cons.text: Free cash flow negatif (-$3.8 M) — bisnis masih membakar kas.
Lonjakan laba sangat besar (+300%) — bila bisnisnya siklikal, P/E rendah di puncak siklus bisa menyesatkan; proyeksi berisiko terlalu optimistis.
Harga sudah 3% di atas estimasi nilai wajar ($307.81).
Estimasi nilai wajar antar-metode berbeda jauh — ketidakpastian proyeksi tinggi.

pros.text: Laba per saham (EPS) diproyeksikan naik 300% — dari $2.39 ke $15.54.
PEG ratio 0.34 — pertumbuhan laba belum sepenuhnya tercermin di harga (GARP: Growth at Reasonable Price).
Margin operasi 24% — tanda pricing power dan keunggulan kompetitif (moat).
21 analis Wall Street, konsensus Buy dengan target rata-rata $344.10 (+9%).
Tren naik terkonfirmasi: harga di atas MA50 & MA200, MA200 menanjak (golden cross aktif).

summary: Air Products and Chemicals, Inc. provides atmospheric gases, process and specialty gases, equipment, and related services in the Americas, Asia, Europe, the Middle East, India, and internationally. The company produces atmospheric gases, including oxygen, nitrogen, and argon; process gases, such as hydrogen, helium, carbon dioxide, carbon monoxide, and syngas; and specialty gases for customers in various industries, including refining, chemical, metals, manufacturing, electronics, energy production, medical, food, chemical and petrochemical manufacturing, oil and gas recovery and processing, a
thesis: Air Products and Chemicals, Inc memiliki fundamental lemah (skor 41/100) dengan keunggulan utama di pertumbuhan (68) dan kualitas bisnis (37). Titik lemahnya ada di kesehatan keuangan (27). Gabungan model DCF, multiple sektor, dan target analis menghasilkan nilai wajar $307.81 — potensi turun 2.7% dalam ~12 bulan (keyakinan rendah). Kondisi teknikal sangat kuat (82/100). Risiko geopolitik sedang, terutama dari tema Perang Dagang & Tarif.
